sources.title: Assisting in Writing Wikipedia-like Articles From Scratch with Large Language Models
permitted_facts: STORM discovers distinct topic perspectives, simulates grounded multi-turn writer/expert conversations, then curates collected information into an outline.
FreshWiki comparison reports +25 percentage points in organization and +10 points in breadth versus an outline-driven RAG baseline.
Expert feedback flags source-bias transfer and over-association of unrelated facts.
sources.relevant_mechanism: Similar-topic article headings seed perspectives; answers to grounded questions create follow-up questions; the resulting conversations guide an outline.
sources.applicability_limit: Evaluated on Wikipedia-like article generation and FreshWiki; it does not establish end-to-end gains on product/plan research.

sources.title: Stanford OVAL STORM / knowledge-storm
sources.version: knowledge-storm 1.1.1; PyPI release 2025-09-29; upstream latest commit observed 2025-09-30
sources.maintenance_observation: Public modular implementation with release history; latest observed release/commit is about one year old, so maintenance recency is weaker than PaperQA2 or GraphRAG.
sources.code_mechanism: STORMWikiRunner exposes do_research and do_generate_outline stages; the package includes configurable language models and web retrievers including Bing, Brave, SearXNG, DuckDuckGo, Tavily, Serper and Google.

sources.title: Language agents achieve superhuman synthesis of scientific knowledge
permitted_facts: The paper evaluates literature retrieval, summarization and contradiction detection against expert researchers.
PaperQA2 identifies 2.34 ± 1.99 contradictions per paper in a random subset of biology papers; human experts validated 70% of flagged contradictions.
sources.relevant_mechanism: A source-search/gather-evidence/answer workflow with claim-sensitive retrieval and evidence contextualization supports cited synthesis and contradiction checking.
sources.applicability_limit: Its evaluation concerns scientific literature; the 70% figure is not a general citation-accuracy estimate.

sources.title: Future-House paper-qa / PaperQA2
sources.maintenance_observation: Tagged release observed 2026-08-12 with ongoing changes.
sources.code_mechanism: Documents candidate papers from a query, ranks top-k chunks for each evidence question, creates relevance-scored contextual summaries, and generates an answer from selected summaries; the agent can choose tool order and follow-up queries.
sources.applicability_limit: Package focuses on local scientific documents and code; the web-source recipe adapts its retrieval loop rather than installing or claiming the package directly executes that workflow.

sources.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
permitted_facts: The method derives an entity knowledge graph from source documents and pre-generates community summaries for related entity groups.
Global queries generate partial responses from community summaries and reduce them into one response.
The paper reports better comprehensiveness and diversity than naive RAG for global sensemaking questions on corpora around one million tokens.
sources.relevant_mechanism: Entity/relationship graph, community summaries, global map/reduce, and local entity-neighborhood retrieval.
sources.applicability_limit: Evidence is for corpus-wide sensemaking; this does not show the method is best for a small product comparison.

sources.title: Microsoft GraphRAG
sources.maintenance_observation: Recent tagged release and repository activity observed within one day of access.
sources.code_mechanism: Indexing creates an entity graph and bottom-up community reports; documented query modes include global community-summary reasoning and local neighborhood fan-out.

sources.title: Information Gain-based Rollout Policy Optimization: An Adaptive Tree-Structured Rollout Approach for Multi-Turn Search Agents
permitted_facts: IGRPO assigns a fixed rollout budget across active search-history nodes using node-level information gain.

Its operational signal is increase in the policy's normalized likelihood of the ground-truth answer after a search state; nodes receive higher softmax expansion probability when their signal is larger.
Reported experiments are search-augmented QA benchmarks and concern agent training.
sources.relevant_mechanism: Parent-child search states, an information-gain value per node, and budget-weighted expansion of more informative branches.
sources.applicability_limit: The manually scored proposition-status change in the recipe is an adaptation; the paper's answer-likelihood reward and benchmark findings are not reproduced.

sources.title: e3trange/IGRPO
sources.version: main branch observed 2026-10-09; no tagged releases visible
sources.maintenance_observation: Official research code linked by the paper; no release tags found. Currentness and long-term maintenance are uncertain.
sources.code_mechanism: Research implementation of adaptive tree-structured rollout-budget allocation for training search-augmented LLM agents; its training stack is not a ready-made external research workflow.
